objective: Conditionally test whether the current residual left after M67 is represented by electron density, mobility, and electron quasi-Fermi-gradient support on the native source-side channel.

support.nodes: M47 source-half Silicon/oxide interface nodes common to both solvers.
support.active_filter: Sentaurus electron-current-density magnitude at least 1e-3 of the per-state source-support maximum.
support.proxy: q*n*mu*|grad(phin)| in A/cm2 for each solver.
support.claim_limit: This is a state-support diagnostic, not an SG/current-extraction intervention or a pointwise equality claim for a finite-volume current.

closed_topic_guards: no quasi-Fermi packing, BGN, mesh, or convergence tuning
